title: Fleet bot STATE.json
description: Initial and runtime state for one Telegram fleet bot. Secrets do not belong in this object. Timestamps are UTC.

bot_id.description: Folder name and Task Queue assignee. One of the five fleet bot ids.

display_name.description: Human display name registered with BotFather.

status.description: IDLE is the seeded waiting state. CLAIMED and WORKING are written before the model call. HALTED stops the loop.

last_task.description: Title of the latest claimed task, or null when no task has been claimed.

last_result.description: One-line redacted result of the latest successful task, or null.

last_error.description: One-line redacted reason for the latest failure, or null.

failure_count.description: Consecutive failed cycles. Two consecutive failures halt the bot.

halted.description: True after a double failure or a startup BLOCKED condition. Stays true until the human sets FLEET_RESUME=1.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the latest state write, or null in the seeded file. The harness writes this before it thinks.

cycle.description: Count of tasks claimed in this state file. Idle polls do not increment it.
